an9.28:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] yato kho gahapati ariyasāvakassa pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti. catuhi ca sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti. so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya:
an9.28:1.2: khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇaapāyaduggativinipāto sotāpanno ‘hamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano,
an9.28:2.1: katamāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti
an9.28:5.1: yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa imāni pañcabhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti, imehi catuhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti, so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya:
an9.28:5.2: khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇaapāyaduggativinipāto sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
